skills.label: Agent setup
skills.desc: Create a reusable, versioned agent configuration.

skills.label: Define outcomes
skills.desc: Tell the agent what 'done' looks like, and let it iterate until it gets there.

skills.label: Dreams
skills.desc: Let Claude review past sessions to curate an agent's memory and surface new insights.

skills.label: Multiagent orchestration
skills.desc: Coordinate multiple agents within a single session.

skills.label: Session budgets
skills.desc: Cap a session's spend with a hard dollar budget enforced at public list rates.

skills.label: Permission policies
skills.desc: Control when agent and MCP tools run.

skills.label: Review and monitor sessions
skills.desc: Optionally review each session's events with an offline job. Watch webhooks for sessions that need attention, and see what Managed Agents keeps and for how long.

skills.label: Risks and boundaries
skills.desc: Why an agent's settings matter for security, and what the Managed Agents sandbox can and cannot do.

skills.label: Scheduled deployments
skills.desc: "Create and manage deployments with the Claude API: run an agent on a recurring cron schedule and inspect its run history."

skills.label: Secure your deployment
skills.desc: The settings that limit what your agents can reach and do, and that protect your Claude API credentials, most important first.

skills.label: Choose an environment
skills.desc: Decide whether Claude Managed Agents tools and code run in an Anthropic-managed cloud environment or a self-hosted sandbox, and see what changes if you switch.

skills.label: Cloud environment setup
skills.desc: Customize cloud sandboxes for your sessions.

skills.label: Cloud sandbox reference
skills.desc: Pre-installed packages, databases, and utilities available in cloud sandboxes.

skills.label: Custom tools and MCP servers
skills.desc: Serve custom tools from a self-hosted sandbox worker, and wrap an MCP server inside your network as custom tools without running a tunnel.

skills.label: Deploy workers
skills.desc: Choose how self-hosted sandbox workers claim work and where sessions run, then run an always-on worker or trigger workers from webhooks.

skills.label: Memory stores
skills.desc: "Attach memory stores to Claude Managed Agents sessions that run in self-hosted sandboxes: prepare the host, configure sync, and handle read-only stores and conflicts."

skills.label: Monitor and troubleshoot
skills.desc: Read queue depth, stop sessions and workers without losing work, and fix common self-hosted sandbox failures.

skills.label: Overview and quickstart
skills.desc: Run Claude Managed Agents sessions in self-hosted sandboxes, keeping tool execution, files, and network egress in your own infrastructure.

skills.label: Security model
skills.desc: Shared responsibility model for self-hosted sandbox environments.

skills.label: Worker reference
skills.desc: "Reference for self-hosted sandbox workers: ant CLI flags, environment variables, host requirements, filesystem paths, and SDK helper options."

skills.label: Build in Console
skills.desc: Create, test, and iterate on agents visually in the Claude Console, then run them from your code with the API.

skills.label: Migration
skills.desc: Move an existing agent built on the Messages API or the Claude Agent SDK to Claude Managed Agents.

skills.label: Overview: Claude Managed Agents overview
skills.desc: Pre-built, configurable agent harness that runs in managed infrastructure. Best for long-running tasks and asynchronous work.

skills.label: Quickstart: Get started with Claude Managed Agents
skills.desc: Create your first autonomous agent.

skills.label: Managed Agents reference
skills.desc: Event types, self-hosted worker CLI flags, supported MCP server types, rate limits, and branding guidelines for Claude Managed Agents.

skills.label: Subscribe to webhooks
skills.desc: Get notified when major events occur without polling.

skills.label: Workflow runs
skills.desc: "Follow an agent's workflow runs: their states and events, when the work is done, requests while a run is open, budgets, and limits."

skills.label: Event deltas
skills.desc: Render the agent's response text as a live preview while the model is still generating it.

skills.label: Inspect and track usage
skills.desc: Inspect a session in the Claude Console, read its token usage and list cost, and debug unexpected agent behavior.

skills.label: Session event stream
skills.desc: Send events, stream responses, and interrupt or redirect your session while it runs.

skills.label: Session operations
skills.desc: Retrieve, list, update, archive, and delete Claude Managed Agents sessions.

skills.label: Session threads
skills.desc: List, interrupt, and archive the threads of a multiagent session, read their events, and handle tool permissions across them.

skills.label: Start a session
skills.desc: Create a session to run your agent and start running tasks.

skills.label: Access GitHub
skills.desc: Connect your agent to GitHub repositories for cloning, reading, and creating pull requests.

skills.label: Agent Skills
skills.desc: Attach pre-built or custom skills to an agent in Claude Managed Agents to give it reusable, filesystem-based expertise for domain-specific workflows.

skills.label: Attach and download files
skills.desc: Upload files and mount them in your sandbox for reading and processing.

skills.label: Authenticate with vaults
skills.desc: Register per-user credentials when creating sessions.

skills.label: MCP connector
skills.desc: Connect MCP servers to your agents for access to external tools and data sources.

skills.label: Memory stores
skills.desc: Give your agents persistent memory that survives across sessions using memory stores.

skills.label: Tools
skills.desc: Configure tools available to your agent.

skills.label: Web tool restrictions
skills.desc: Control which sites an agent's web search and web fetch tools can reach, cap fetched content, and localize search results.
